title: Machine Learning Crash Course
tagline: Build, test and ship honest machine learning models with scikit-learn.
description: Most machine learning tutorials stop at a high accuracy score. This course starts where real projects start: a business question, a messy table and a baseline that any model has to beat. You predict which customers of Cartwheel, an online store, will stop ordering, and you learn regression, classification, trees, ensembles and neural networks by building them in scikit-learn.

Every idea comes with a picture, a few lines of code you run in the browser and a check on what the numbers really mean. You learn the habits that separate a demo from a model people can trust: cross-validation, pipelines, leakage hunting, threshold choices, fairness checks and monitoring after launch. The maths is shown with code and diagrams, not pages of notation.
audience: Analysts and developers who know some Python and pandas and want to build machine learning models they can defend.
prerequisites: Basic Python and pandas: loading a CSV, selecting columns and filtering rows. No maths beyond school algebra.
learnItems: Frame a business question as a supervised learning problem
Train and compare models with fit, predict and score
Choose metrics that match the cost of each kind of mistake
Build leak-free pipelines with ColumnTransformer and cross-validation
Tune hyperparameters and engineer features that move the score
Check a model for bias, monitor drift and ship it behind an API
